method: Same production host, sequential requests, keep-alive, three warmups excluded, backend order rotated each round. Legacy is the previous deployed bundle with its original Remix server on an isolated loopback port; web is the deployed Rust-backed path including Node forwarding; direct is Rust without Node forwarding. Times include complete raw body transfer to this Node client, excluding concatenation/hash calculation. Every response body matches by SHA-256; ranges and gzip stay byte-identical. No provider, browser rendering, WAN/TLS, cold disk, or concurrent-load measurement. Normal production traffic may add noise. p95 uses nearest rank.
